battle.name: 沃加斯蒂斯堡戰役
battle.theater: 美索不達米亞兩河間沃加斯蒂斯堡
battle.brief: 631年，薩珊統帥沙赫巴巴茲於美索不達米亞兩河間的沃加斯蒂斯堡，擊潰拜占庭皇帝希拉克略之子君士坦丁率領的東征軍。卡面亞述長矛屬公元前九世紀上半葉的短柄長刃工藝，與本役相隔一千五百餘年，只能在戰術位置上對應薩珊重步兵的長矛線：此役兩軍盾矛在堡壘缺口前貼身搏鬥，金飾長矛亦為薩珊繳獲。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 631年的兩河間地帶，交戰一方是拜占庭帝國，另一方是薩珊帝國。拜占庭由皇帝希拉克略一世坐鎮御前、把持帝國的軍政樞紐，東線野戰交由兒子君士坦丁率領，兵員以來自歐洲的軍團、首都近衛騎士以及亞美尼亞、格魯吉亞盟軍編成的混合部隊為主；北方戰線同時要頂住阿瓦爾人與西突厥的進逼，首都君士坦丁堡在626年遭大圍攻之後仍處在戰爭狀態，動員能力有限。薩珊方面，國王卡瓦德二世在628年弒父即位後已與拜占庭訂立和約，但他不肯交出既得城市；主張繼續進攻的沙赫巴巴茲、毗羅茲等將領遭到清洗，直到629至630年沙赫巴巴茲起兵反叛、擊敗中央軍、控制泰西封，才重新握有對拜占庭開戰的權力。其麾下是薩珊常備軍與美索不達米亞總督轄下的軍區部隊：禁軍重步兵帶大盾與長矛，地方徵召兵多為弓手，另有以軍區為單位臨時集結的騎兵。631年薩珊在位的國王已換成年幼的雅爾達希爾三世，但戰役的實際策劃與前線指揮仍握在沙赫巴巴茲手中。
countriesEn: The war in the alluvial plain between the two rivers in 631 was fought between the Byzantine Empire and the Sasanian Empire. On the Byzantine side Emperor Heraclius I held court and directed the empire's military and administrative machinery, while field command on the eastern front was handed to his son Constantine; the field army was a mixed force made up of Roman regiments drawn from Europe, the capital's guard cavalry, and contingents supplied by Armenia and Georgia. The northern front had at the same time to hold off the Avars and the Western Turks, and Constantinople was still only a few years past the great siege of 626, so the empire's capacity to mobilise was limited. On the Sasanian side, Kavad II, who had taken the throne by murdering his father in 628, had already concluded a peace with Byzantium, but he refused to surrender the cities the war had brought him; the generals who wanted the war carried on, Shahrbaraz and Peroz among them, were purged, and only after Shahrbaraz rose in revolt in 629–630, beat the central army and seized Ctesiphon did the Persians once more have the power to make war on Byzantium. Under him stood the Sasanian standing forces and the levies of the Mesopotamian provinces: heavy infantry of the imperial guard carrying large shields and long spears, local recruits mostly armed as archers, and cavalry mustered in wartime from the provincial military districts. In 631 the crowned king of Persia was the boy Ardashir III, but the planning of the campaign and the command on the ground were still in Shahrbaraz's hands.
people: 希拉克略一世是這場戰役最關鍵的遠方決策者。602年開戰時他尚未即位，610年才登基；此後他以一連串反攻收復安提阿、耶路撒冷與亞歷山大港，627年在尼尼微之戰大敗薩珊主力，卻在628年看著自己的兒子胡斯勞二世被弒、其弟卡瓦德二世接班議和。628年的和約確認了拜占庭的疆界，卻只讓希拉克略得到復國而非雪恥；631年他把突擊美索不達米亞的任務交給君士坦丁，自己坐鎮北方策應與突厥人的牽制，戰敗消息傳來時已是晚境。君士坦丁是沙赫巴巴茲的直接對手，年輕而缺乏大戰經驗，率軍深入平原後在沃加斯蒂斯堡外被合圍，僅以殘部退走，連希拉克略贈予象徵繼承權的金飾長矛也淪為對方戰利品。卡瓦德二世是薩珊的實際掌權者，也是自628年起整頓土地與軍制的改革者，他既敢弒父奪位，最後也不得不容忍元帥的反叛。沙赫巴巴茲則是戰役的實際主帥，他留下的卡巴耶阿爾達希爾銘文自述擊敗羅馬軍、攻破沃加斯蒂斯堡，並一度打算直取君士坦丁堡；這位驕兵最終在631年或632年被自己人刺殺，薩珊的攻勢隨之瓦解。編年史方面，提奧菲拉克特·西莫卡塔的史著與《851年編年史》保存了戰役經過與金矛交涉的主要敘述。
peopleEn: Heraclius I was the distant decision-maker in all of this. He was not yet on the throne when the war began in 602, and only became emperor in 610; he then turned the tide with a series of counter-offensives that recovered Antioch, Jerusalem and Alexandria, and destroyed the Sasanian main army at the Battle of Nineveh in 627. Yet he had to watch his own son Hormizd II be murdered in 628 and his brother Kavad II take over and make peace. That peace confirmed Byzantium's frontiers but gave Heraclius a restored kingdom rather than revenge, and in 631 he entrusted the task of striking into Mesopotamia to Constantine, remaining in the north to coordinate the counter-stroke and the distraction against the Turks. The bad news of the defeat reached him late. Constantine was Shahrbaraz's direct opposite: young and without experience of a great battle, he pushed into the plain with his army, was enveloped outside Vougatis and escaped with the remnants alone, losing even the gold-headed spear his father had given him as a token of hereditary right. Kavad II was the real ruler in Persia and the reformer who from 628 onward began to reorganise the land system and the army; he had the nerve to murder his father and yet still had to tolerate his generals' rebellion. Shahrbaraz was the actual field commander, and the inscription he left at the Ka'ba-ye Ardashir boasts of defeating the Roman army, breaking Vougatis and briefly aspiring to march on Constantinople; this over-mighty soldier was murdered by his own men in 631 or 632, and with him the Sasanian offensive came apart. For the written record, the history of Theophylact Simocatta and the Chronicle of 851 preserve the principal narrative of the battle and of the business over the golden spear.
kits: 卡面這柄亞述長矛屬公元前九世紀上半葉的工藝：短柄、長刃、配鐵鏃，是亞述方陣近戰的骨幹兵器，與柳條小盾、弓、箭袋、短斧同時配發。公元前612年尼尼微陷落後亞述王國覆亡，這件兵器本身早已不復存在，但短柄長刃矛的形制在兩河流域的兵刃傳統中並未斷絕；到631年，薩珊重步兵裝備的是另一種制式長矛，柄長逾兩公尺，一端為長鐵矛頭，配大弧形盾與斧；拜占庭的近戰步兵則以盾矛兵為主，使用圓盾與短柄長矛，排成密集的盾牆。除冷兵器外，雙方都倚重弓矢：薩珊弓手的齊射與反覆齊射是公認的強項，631年交鋒前正是靠弓手前出擾亂、掩護長矛線展開。騎兵是薩珊的機動主力，重甲具裝騎兵用於迂迴包抄，輕騎用於追擊與切斷退路；拜占庭同樣以具裝騎兵與弓騎混編應戰。攻城方面，拜占庭有成熟的撞錘、塔樓與雲梯，薩珊則以填壕器材、雲梯與撞錘進攻，雙方都靠駱駝隊、馬車與河船輸送糧秣。金飾長矛則是這一役最著名的裝備：它並非實戰兵器，而是皇帝授予繼承人的榮譽與授權信物，卻在沃加斯蒂斯堡被薩珊軍繳獲，成為薩珊炫耀戰勝的憑證。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card belongs to the armourer's craft of the first half of the ninth century BC: a short shaft, a long blade and an iron head, the backbone of close combat in the Assyrian phalanx, issued together with a wicker buckler, a bow, a quiver and a short axe. After the fall of Nineveh in 612 BC the Assyrian kingdom was gone and this weapon had long ceased to exist as a service item, though the short-hafted, long-bladed spear survived in the arms tradition of Mesopotamia. By 631 the Sasanian heavy infantry carried a different regulation spear, its shaft more than two metres long and tipped with a long iron head, used together with a large curved shield and an axe; the Byzantine close-combat infantry consisted of scutarii, armed with round shields and short-hafted spears and drawn up in dense shield walls. Beyond cold weapons, both sides leaned heavily on the bow: the Sasanian archers' massed and repeated volleys were a recognised strength, and it was their forward shooting that covered the opening of the spear line in the fighting before Vougatis. Cavalry was the Persian arm of manoeuvre, armoured heavy horse for outflanking and envelopment, light horse for pursuit and for cutting the enemy's road back; Byzantium answered with its own cataphracts and mixed mounted archers. For siege work Byzantium had mature rams, towers and ladders, while the Persians attacked with filling materials, ladders and rams of their own, and both sides moved grain and stores on camel trains, wagons and river boats. The gold-headed spear is the most famous piece of equipment in the story: it was not a weapon for fighting but a badge of honour and investiture given by the emperor to his heir, and it was carried off by the Sasanian army at Vougatis, becoming the trophy with which Persia boasted of her victory.
tactics: 拜占庭的戰術框架是希拉克略多次使用的反守為攻與騎兵迂迴：以盾矛步兵和弓手組成正面，以具裝騎兵在兩翼和敵後機動，627年的尼尼微之戰正是靠迂迴打亂薩珊重步兵才取勝。631年的君士坦丁把同一套邏輯搬到平原上，卻遇上準備充分的對手：沙赫巴巴茲不急於迎戰，而是利用沃加斯蒂斯堡周邊灌溉渠縱橫、城垣與居民點密布的地形，把拜占庭縱隊拉成數段，再在開闊處合圍。接戰時，薩珊以重步兵持長矛列陣形成長矛線，弓手在陣前反覆齊射後退回陣後裝填，形成所謂波斯式覆蓋射擊；拜占庭的圓盾線在這種消耗與遮蔽下難以維持推進，兩翼的具裝騎兵隨即向其縱隊側後迂迴，逼迫其收縮於堡壘缺口與堤道之間。得手之後，薩珊騎兵反覆切斷對方退路、纏鬥至入夜，奪取旗幟與金矛，並收攏大量俘虜和裝備。掩護與補給上，拜占庭遠離帝國核心，糧秣依賴車隊與隨軍馬匹，穿越美索不達米亞酷熱缺水、蟲蚊叢生的沼澤與渠道地帶時效率極低；薩珊軍則可就地取糧、靠底格里斯河與運河網維持，佔城為基地，攻守皆不吃虧。短柄長刃的亞述式長矛在這類地形仍有其位置：狹窄缺口內的近身反覆刺擊，正是短柄器比長柄器更為靈活的地方。
tacticsEn: The Byzantine tactical template was the one Heraclius had used repeatedly: turn defence into offence and work the cavalry round the enemy, forming the front with spearmen and archers and keeping the armoured horse on the wings and in the enemy's rear. It was precisely by such a movement that the Persians' heavy infantry was thrown into disorder at Nineveh in 627. In 631 Constantine carried the same logic out onto the plain, and met a properly prepared opponent. Shahrbaraz was in no hurry to engage: he used the ground around Vougatis, cut everywhere by irrigation channels, crowded with fortification walls and settlements, to pull the Byzantine column into several separate segments and then closed around them in the open. At the moment of contact the Persians formed a spear line with heavy infantry, while archers stepped forward to shoot and fell back behind the line to reload, producing the so-called Persian covering fire. The Byzantine round shields could not keep their advance under that expenditure and cover, and the armoured horse on the wings immediately wheeled behind the flanks of the Byzantine column, pressing it back into the gaps of the fortification and onto the embankments. Having won the day, Persian horse cut the enemy's road back again and again, fought them into the night, took the standards and the golden spear, and gathered up a large number of prisoners and the enemy's equipment. In matters of cover and supply, the Byzantines were far from the core of the empire, drew their grain from wagon trains and remounts, and moved with great inefficiency through the marshes and canal country of Mesopotamia, where the heat, the lack of water and the mosquitoes were as hostile as the enemy. The Persian army, for its part, could live off the country, maintain itself by the Tigris and the network of canals, and make the cities its bases, so that neither attacking nor holding cost it dearly. The short-hafted, long-bladed spear in the Assyrian manner still had its place in such terrain: in a narrow breach, repeated close-range thrusts are exactly where a short-hafted weapon is more agile than a long one.
data: 可考的數字多半來自編年史的量級描述，而非精確統計。整場拜占庭與薩珊的戰爭自602年開打到628年議和，歷時約26年，主戰階段一般記作八至九次大規模戰役。631年這一役本身，戰鬥集中在數日之內，其後的追擊與掃蕩又延續數日。兵力方面，拜占庭東軍為數萬人規模，由歐洲軍團、首都近衛與亞美尼亞、格魯吉亞盟軍拼合而成；薩珊方面同樣是數萬人，包括禁軍、美索不達米亞駐軍與地方徵召兵，另有大量弓手與騎兵。地理上，沃加斯蒂斯堡位於兩河間地帶，學界多將其暫定於今伊拉克瓦西特一帶；自該處至拜占庭在幼發拉底河上游的前線約數百公里，薩珊軍得勝後的推進因此仍以數百公里計。損失方面，史料只以慘重、多被俘獲一類字眼描述，確數不可考，只能確定拜占庭方面的死傷與被俘是以萬計，軍旗、器械與金飾長矛悉數淪陷。時間上另有兩個座標：卡瓦德二世在631年即位後旋即去世，雅爾達希爾三世在位僅一年多便讓位給兄弟；戰敗後的重新議約在632年前後完成，而阿拉伯人自634年起進入兩河流域，637至639年間接管美索不達米亞，說明這場會戰的勝負並未改變長遠走向。
dataEn: The figures that can be cited come mostly from the scale of the chroniclers' descriptions rather than from any exact reckoning. The Byzantine–Sasanian war as a whole ran from the opening of hostilities in 602 to the peace of 628, a matter of some twenty-six years, and its main phase is generally counted as eight or nine large battles. The battle of 631 itself was fought over a matter of days, with the pursuit and mopping-up lasting a few days more. On strength, the Byzantine eastern army was on the order of tens of thousands, pieced together from the European regiments, the capital's guard and the Armenian and Georgian contingents; the Persian side was of comparable order, comprising the guard, the Mesopotamian garrisons and local levies, with large numbers of archers and cavalry besides. Geographically, Vougatis lay in the interfluve between the two rivers, and scholars generally place it tentatively in the neighbourhood of al-Wāsiṭ in modern Iraq; from there to the Byzantine frontier on the upper Euphrates is a matter of several hundred kilometres, so even the victorious Persian advance was still measured in hundreds of kilometres. On losses, the sources say only that the defeat was heavy and that many were taken prisoner; the exact numbers are not recoverable, and all that can be said with certainty is that the Byzantine dead and captive were numbered in thousands of men while the standards, the siege equipment and the golden spear were lost entirely. Two further dates frame the affair: Kavad II died soon after his accession in 631, and Ardashir III's reign lasted only a little over a year before he gave way to his brother; the treaty renegotiated after the defeat was completed around 632, and the Arabs, entering Mesopotamia from 634, took the province in 637–639, which shows that the result of this battle changed nothing in the long run.
cause: 直接導火線是628年之後薩珊王室的權力重組。602年胡斯勞二世以羅馬皇帝謀殺其盟友為由入侵美索不達米亞，兩年內連陷達拉、卡爾佩、埃德薩、安提阿、耶路撒冷與亞歷山大港，拜占庭一度只剩小亞細亞與埃及；622年起希拉克略自亞美尼亞反攻，626年首都遭阿瓦爾人圍城時他仍在波斯前線，627年尼尼微之戰更摧毀薩珊主力，邊界一度推回幼發拉底河上游。628年二月胡斯勞二世被兒子沙珊德赫特弒殺，新君願與拜占庭議和，卻拒絕放棄佔領的美索不達米亞城邑；和約議定後，主戰的元帥被一併清除，激起沙赫巴巴茲在629至630年的反叛，薩珊再度由反叛者掌權。對拜占庭而言，631年的東征正是要趁薩珊繼承危機與北方牽制並舉，把和約簽訂時未竟的攻勢倒過來推回去；對薩珊而言，這是要在內亂剛定、軍心未復的情況下，證明帝國仍能跨境作戰，並把拜占庭在627年之後得到的邊界全部奪回。雙方都清楚對方正在削弱，於是兩個尚有餘力的軍隊在兩河間地帶相遇。
causeEn: The immediate spark was the reshuffling of power in the Sasanian court after 628. In 602 Hormizd II invaded Byzantine Mesopotamia on the pretext that a Roman emperor had murdered his ally, and within two years had taken Dara, Carrhae, Edessa, Antioch, Jerusalem and Alexandria, leaving Byzantium at one point with only Asia Minor and Egypt. From 622 Heraclius counter-attacked from Armenia; in 626, when Constantinople was besieged by the Avars, he was himself on the Persian front; and the battle of Nineveh in 627 destroyed the Sasanian main army and pushed the frontier back to the upper Euphrates. In February 628 Hormizd II was murdered by his son Shushandukht, who was willing to make peace with Byzantium but refused to give up the Mesopotamian cities the war had brought; once the treaty was settled the war party among the generals was purged as well, which provoked Shahrbaraz's revolt in 629–630 and put Persia once more in the hands of a rebel. For Byzantium the eastern campaign of 631 was an attempt to exploit the Sasanian succession crisis and the simultaneous distraction in the north, and to push back through the other side the offensive that the treaty of 628 had left unfinished. For Persia it was a demonstration, at a moment when the internal crisis had just been settled and the army's morale was not yet restored, that the empire could still wage war across the frontier, and to take back everything Byzantium had won after 627. Each side knew that the other was weakened; two armies that still had strength met in the plain between the two rivers.
impact: 短期影響是戰線第二次逆轉。拜占庭在和約中勉強收回的埃德薩等城，631年再度易手，邊界退回到幼發拉底河上游的舊日防線；希拉克略的聲望與其子君士坦丁的軍事生涯同時受損，首都朝野對東線的信任下降，北方戰線的資源被分薄。對薩珊而言，631年的勝利是一場真正的會戰勝利，甚至帶來直取君士坦丁堡的野心，沙赫巴巴茲的銘文把這一勝利寫得淋漓盡致。但戰勝者本人隨即在631年或632年被刺身亡，繼位的雅爾達希爾三世面對內部不穩與北方壓力，只能在632年前後重新與拜占庭議約，承認既有的邊界，前功盡棄。長遠看，這場戰役是薩珊軍最後一次展現大規模跨境打擊能力，也暴露其致命弱點：帝國一旦失去能獨當一面的統帥，反應迅速轉為守勢。中東在此後數年發生根本轉變，634年阿拉伯軍興起，637至639年間美索不達米亞落入新王朝統治，拜占庭與薩珊兩強長期競爭的舞台被徹底改寫；而沃加斯蒂斯堡這樣的堡壘，與它相連的灌溉渠與兩河水道，此後都變成了新秩序的地理骨架。
impactEn: In the short term the line swung back for the second time in a decade. The cities such as Edessa that Byzantium had grudgingly recovered under the peace changed hands again in 631, and the frontier fell back to the old defences on the upper Euphrates; Heraclius's prestige and his son Constantine's military standing were damaged together, confidence in the eastern front in the capital declined, and resources were thinned out along the northern theatre. For Persia the victory of 631 was a real victory in the field, and it even brought the ambition of marching on Constantinople, which the inscription of Shahrbaraz sets out with a flourish. But the victor was himself murdered in 631 or 632, and Ardashir III, who succeeded him, facing internal disorder and pressure from the north, could do nothing but renew the treaty with Byzantium around 632 and confirm the existing borders, so that the whole gain was thrown away. In the longer run this battle was the last time the Sasanian army showed that it could strike across a frontier on a large scale, and it exposed the fatal weakness of the state: once it lost a commander able to command by himself, its reaction turned at once to the defensive. The Middle East changed at the root within a few years: the Arab armies rose in 634, and between 637 and 639 Mesopotamia passed to the rule of a new dynasty, so that the stage on which Byzantium and Persia had fought for so long was rewritten from the ground up. Fortresses like Vougatis, and the irrigation channels and the waterways of the two rivers that ran past them, became the geographical skeleton of the new order.
result: 結果是薩珊的會戰勝利：拜占庭東軍在沃加斯蒂斯堡外被合圍潰散，君士坦丁僅以身免，軍旗、器械與那柄象徵皇權的金飾長矛全部落入薩珊手中，官兵被俘者以萬計，埃德薩一帶隨即回到薩珊控制之下；薩珊軍得勢後推進到幼發拉底河東岸，威脅拜占庭的邊境城邑。然而勝利並未轉化為戰果：沙赫巴巴茲被自己人刺殺，攻勢在半途停住，新王雅爾達希爾三世在632年前後與希拉克略重訂和約，確認舊有邊界，埃德薩歸還拜占庭。附帶插曲是金矛的追索：薩珊方面要求歸還希拉克略贈給兒子的那柄金飾長矛，希拉克略一度矢口否認，後來只得以仿製的金矛應付，被識破後才承認失落，成為史家筆下的笑柄。整體而言，602至628年那場大戰的最終格局並未因631年的會戰而改變：美索不達米亞在632年後回到拜占庭手中約數年，隨後轉入阿拉伯統治；薩珊得到了最後一場勝利，卻把國力耗在內鬥與北疆壓力上，數年後便再無力東進。
resultEn: The result was a Sasanian victory in the field: the Byzantine eastern army was enveloped and broken outside Vougatis, Constantine escaped with his life alone, the standards and the siege equipment and the gold-headed spear that stood for imperial authority all fell into Persian hands, and the number of officers and men taken prisoner was counted in thousands; Edessa and its neighbourhood went back under Sasanian control, and the victorious Persian army advanced to the east bank of the Euphrates, threatening the Byzantine frontier towns. Yet the victory did not turn into results: Shahrbaraz was murdered by his own men, the offensive stopped halfway, and the new king Ardashir III had to renegotiate the treaty with Heraclius around 632, confirming the old borders and handing Edessa back to Byzantium. The side episode is the business of the golden spear: the Persians demanded the return of the gold-headed spear Heraclius had given his son, and Heraclius for a while denied flatly that it had been lost, then could only send a replica, which was recognised as such and left him with no choice but to admit the loss — a story the historians have treated as a joke. Taken as a whole, the final shape of the great war of 602–628 was not altered by the battle of 631: Mesopotamia returned to Byzantine hands after 632 for a few years before passing to Arab rule; Persia had won its last victory, but had spent its strength on internal dissension and pressure on the northern frontier, and within a few years it could advance no further.
